title: Chapter 1
description:
Beginning

33 years old. 2026.

There's 500,000 won in the bank.
Father's debt — all paid off. What's left is this room. And this number.

Everyone said it was too late.
He starts anyway.

title: Chapter 2
description:
Expansion

34 years old. 2027.

The doors to a world he never knew begin to open.
That money calls money. That people create opportunity.
A year ago, he didn't know this.

Now he does.

title: Chapter 3
description:
Weight

35 years old. 2028.

The price of the path he chose comes due.
If he played it safe — the weight of monotony.
If he went off the beaten path — the weight of risk.

Neither is light.

title: Chapter 4
description:
Fracture

36 years old. 2029.

People are the biggest variable.
Someone you trusted shakes everything.
Someone you didn't expect steadies you.

Numbers can be predicted. People cannot.

title: Chapter 5
description:
Gangnam

37 years old. 2030.

This is the final year.
With the hand he's holding now — it's time to go all in.

The last of five years.
